news.title: Malone installed as Nancy and Kenneth Kranzberg Curator
news.summary_en: Meredith Malone was installed as the Nancy and Kenneth Kranzberg Curator at the WashU Kemper Art Museum May 18. The endowed position is the museum’s first named curatorship.

news.title: Building better workplaces for an aging workforce
news.summary_en: As Americans work longer than previous generations, employers have an opportunity to create workplaces that support employees of all ages, according to a new article by Cal Halvorsen, associate professor at the WashU Brown School.
